title: Undo reverts the previous edit after brushing, right-click deselect, Enter on groups, or keyboard traversal
reason: Reports several tldraw selection changes not creating their own stopping point, so Undo reverts an earlier document edit. The report is specific to tldraw’s history model where selection is captured with history.
assessment: Varve tracks selection refinement separately from document history and its updateDoc contract preserves selection stacks; the selection-only undo behavior differs. No matching four-case path is established by this report.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve tracks selection refinement separately from document history and its updateDoc contract preserves selection stacks; the selection-only undo behavior differs. No matching four-case path is established by this report.

title: Undo after switching pages also reverts the previous edit
reason: Reports page navigation being merged into an earlier tldraw edit, causing one Undo to both revert the edit and switch pages. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve page navigation calls `setActivePage`, which updates the document through `updateDoc`; outside an explicit compound transaction, updateDoc creates its own undo snapshot. Page navigation therefore has a distinct history entry.

title: Only the left Shift key gives the large nudge step
reason: Reports tldraw checking physical ShiftLeft instead of the logical Shift state, so right Shift does not select the large nudge step. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve’s nudge step reads the normalized `KeyboardEvent.shiftKey` state rather than testing a physical left-side key code, so either Shift key selects the large step.

title: Delete key deletes a child of a locked frame while the menu item is disabled
reason: Reports the Delete keyboard shortcut removing a child of a locked frame even though the context menu disables deletion. The sole comment confirms fix #10334 checks locked ancestors.
assessment: Varve `removeSelected` filters selected nodes through `isNodeEffectivelyLocked`, which walks ancestor locks before deletion. Keyboard deletion and menu deletion share this command path.
